lead.title: Implicity raises $40M led by IRIS with Five Arrows for its AI cardiac remote monitoring platform
lead.deck: Implicity aggregates, normalises and analyses data from cardiac implantable electronic devices (CIEDs) and heart failure monitoring regardless of manufacturer, with EHR integration; its algorithms, certified as medical devices and FDA-cleared, include SignalHF, which predicts heart failure risk, and an ECG Analyzer that cuts false alarms by up to 76%, with the company claiming a 26% reduction in mortality versus conventional remote monitoring. The round, led by European growth investor IRIS with Five Arrows (Rothschild & Co), will fund US commercial hiring from its Cambridge, Massachusetts base and the next generation of algorithms: proof that the value in remote monitoring, now the standard of care in cardiology, is shifting from the sensor to the vendor-agnostic software layer.

milestone.title: medatixx publishes the FHIR specification of its HealthHub on Simplifier, now connected to more than 25 third-party solutions
milestone.summary: One year after launch, the standardised gateway linking the medatixx, psyx and x.isynet practice software to external applications (digital patient history, online reception and booking, AI phone assistants, video consultations, digital initial assessment) counts more than 25 partner solutions and more than 2,000 users; since October, a 'Clinical Intelligence' module has added clinical decision support with Prof. Valmed and Praedigo.
milestone.why: medatixx equips more than 30% of human-medicine practices in Germany (over 48,000 physicians and psychotherapists): by publishing its specification, the vendor turns its software into an integration marketplace, a direct distribution channel for startups that until now ran into the practice-software bottleneck.

brefsEurope.title: Ireland's Spryt, maker of AI receptionist Asa, named Startup of the Year at the National Startup Awards
brefsEurope.summary: The startup took the Grand Prix in Dublin on November 19, along with gold in the Tech and Export categories. Asa lets patients book, change and pay for appointments via SMS, WhatsApp or Messenger and helps providers anticipate no-shows; Spryt claims attendance improvements of more than 160% in the NHS, pilots in the US, Saudi Arabia and the UAE, and a strategic investment from MediDrive that valued it at $12.5M earlier this year.

brefsEurope.title: HealthAI wins the 10th Desafío e-Dea Salud with AI agents for MRI scheduling at Ramón y Cajal hospital
brefsEurope.summary: Its generative-AI and agent-based solution automates scheduling, calendar and incident management, anticipates no-shows and makes it easier to reassign slots, under radiologists' supervision; it beat Health Force Technologies and Omniloy before a jury from the hospital, the Pfizer Foundation and Wayra (Telefónica). The prize: €2,500 and the chance to apply for a Richi Lifesciences programme fellowship in Boston.

brefsEurope.title: French MPs pass the 'resilience' bill transposing NIS2 at first reading, without subjecting all software vendors to it
brefsEurope.summary: The bill, voted on November 17, will regulate thousands of healthcare entities; MPs removed the inclusion of all software vendors, whatever their size, among essential entities, a measure that 'mainly targeted healthcare software vendors', according to rapporteur Éric Bothorel. France, taken to the CJEU for missing the October 17, 2024 deadline, is speeding up: a direct signal for healthcare cybersecurity players, whose regulated market is widening.

brefsEurope.title: Essex ICB prepares a joint online consultation purchase for 204 GP practices
brefsEurope.summary: The health body, covering 1.9 million people, is targeting an initial two-year contract from spring 2027 to replace a patchwork of local tools; an online supplier showcase is scheduled for December 9 (registration by December 3, Find a Tender notice 109218-2026), with no value or procurement structure set yet. A consolidation tender to watch for online triage and consultation vendors.

brefsEurope.company: Black Country Healthcare NHS Foundation Trust
brefsEurope.title: Black Country Healthcare goes live with the Portasana patient portal for its mental health and community services
brefsEurope.summary: Rolled out under a three-year agreement, the platform lets patients manage appointments, receive reminders and digital letters and complete questionnaires; it integrates with the NHS App, the Rio electronic patient record and hybrid mail, and replaces several manual processes for clinical and admin teams across Dudley, Sandwell, Walsall and Wolverhampton.

brefsEurope.title: Baden-Württemberg unveils its 'Gesundheit 2030' strategy: preventive and digital before outpatient and hospital care
brefsEurope.summary: Health minister Oliver Hildenbrand plans AI-assisted patient navigation, outpatient and inpatient care that is 'highly digitised and data-driven', and a shift of standardised tasks, monitoring and case management to non-physician professionals equipped with digital tools and AI. A regional roadmap that opens the door to triage and remote follow-up platforms.

brefsIntl.title: Imagen raises more than $100M in 2026 and secures access to 150 million studies to train its radiology AI
brefsIntl.summary: The remote radiology practice, whose radiologist headcount is doubling year on year, will fund hiring and clinical resources, and has secured rights to up to 150 million additional studies (X-ray, CT, MRI, ultrasound) to train and validate its models. A comparable for European teleradiology players betting on vertical integration of radiologists plus AI.

brefsIntl.title: ONC makes the US Virgin Islands the first national implementation site of its TEFCA data-exchange initiative
brefsIntl.summary: The roughly $600,000, 12-month federal contract awarded to Team Zane (Zane Networks, net.America and CRISP Shared Services) will assess hospital and clinic readiness, deliver an interoperability, cybersecurity and governance roadmap, and support the creation of a non-profit Health Data Utility, before scaling to tribal and rural systems. A 'small territory first' model worth watching for EHDS implementation.

word.field: Access to care and capacity management
word.definition: AI models that estimate, for each appointment, the probability that the patient will not turn up or will cancel at the last minute, so the patient can be reminded or rebooked, or the slot reassigned, before it is lost.

parts.label: Data
parts.role: attendance history, appointment type and non-clinical factors

parts.label: Risk score
parts.role: the probability of a no-show or late cancellation, appointment by appointment

parts.label: Action
parts.role: targeted reminders, back-up bookings or slot reassignment

how.t: The model learns from the organisation's attended, missed and last-minute cancelled appointments.
Each upcoming appointment gets a risk score, letting booking teams focus on the cases to watch.
High-risk appointments trigger personalised reminders (SMS, WhatsApp, call) or slot reassignment, under the supervision of clinical teams.

word.why: Missed appointments cost the NHS more than £2bn a year according to Deep Medical, which counts 8 million missed appointments and 4 million short-notice cancellations, and US providers $150bn a year according to Spryt. For a VC, it is one of the few AI use cases with an immediately measurable ROI in recovered slots, sold to operations leaders rather than clinicians, and a natural complement to conversational booking agents.
